messages:
maria_g: heads-up — overnight eval alerted on the nightwatch run for model `redwood-open-7b-int4-v2`

maria_g: failing cohort: long-answer-instructions (accuracy drop ~18% vs float baseline) :alarm_clock:

maria_g: sample outputs look shorter, more hallucinated facts, and dropping to default template a lot

andrew_k: can you paste one failing example?

maria_g: sure, from the repo:```input: 'Explain how escrow works for a house sale in plain terms.'baseline: 'Escrow is... (long explanation)'model: 'Escrow means you keep money safe.'```

andrew_k: ugh concise fallback. what's the seed / temperature for the eval?

maria_g: eval config: `temp=0.0, top_p=1.0, max_new_tokens=256`, deterministic sampling. run id 5132109999

lee_s: eval-alert-bot posted the suite result: `nightwatch/long-answer-instructions` failed threshold at 02:14 UTC. alert severity: medium.

eval-alert-bot: automated note: cohort failure rate = 12/62 prompts above threshold; avg length down 42 tokens; regression delta -0.18 vs baseline.

andrew_k: quick checks: (1) was this run on the int4 kernel or fallback path? (2) kv-cache behavior?

maria_g: int4 runtime used. kernel tag `qkernel-v3` in logs. KV cache warmup ok — cache hits similar to baseline

lee_s: can we repro locally with the same model weight and runtime? assign to andrew_k to attempt repro. @andrew_k you okay to own for now?

andrew_k: taking it. first step: run small repro with the exact checkpoint and `--deterministic` flags. I'll run on prod-sim node and post diff. ETA 45m

maria_g: thanks — also attaching a pair of failing sample IDs: [LA-021, LA-034, LA-049]

andrew_k: quick grep in logs: noticed `topk override` message for one request: `runtime: applied top_k=5 override via policy` — wonder if route policy bumped truncation heuristics

lee_s: that could explain shorter outputs if top_k enforced. which policy? ops-bot should have audit log

ops-bot: audit log snippet: `policy: cost-saver-v1` triggered at 02:13:58 for tenant "nightwatch-eval"; action=apply_topk(5) scope=request

maria_g: oh interesting — cost-saver shouldn't be applied to eval traffic. maybe routing mismap to hosted tier?

andrew_k: if policy forced top_k=5 then deterministic sampling at temp=0 would produce very short, repeated tokens — matches the symptom. need to confirm sampling clipping in runtime path for quantized kernels

lee_s: owner action items: andrew repro + confirm sampling behavior on qkernel with top_k override; maria confirm that eval runs should be pinned to internal tier (no cost-saver policy); i'll update incident card and set severity=medium for now

maria_g: noted — I'm checking eval-run config and routing tags now. if that's mislabelled, I'll requeue the run after fix and re-run the nightly suite

andrew_k: quick local repro: ran command:```./tools/run_eval.sh --model redwood-open-7b-int4-v2 --run 5132109999 --override-topk 5 --deterministic```observed same short answers. switching off topk override produces baseline-like outputs

andrew_k: conclusion: top_k override in serving policy is primary signal. quant kernel respects override and sampling degenerates when top_k small at temp=0

lee_s: next steps: (1) patch routing so `nightwatch-eval` tag bypasses cost-saver policy (maria) (2) add guard in runtime to ignore top_k overrides for eval/internal routes (eng-runtime follow-up) (3) rerun nightly suite and verify delta (andrew)

maria_g: I'll fix the run tag mapping and requeue. requeue ETA 10m once mapping pushed

andrew_k: I'll schedule a quick post-mortem doc after rerun with sample diffs and a tiny reproducer script to prevent regressions

lee_s: assigning eng-runtime follow-up to `assigned: eng-runtime@oncall` in the incident card. severity stays medium until rerun clears

maria_g: thanks all — I'll post results here after rerun

andrew_k: thanks — ping me if rerun still fails, we'll escalate to kernel folks

ops-bot: rerun queued as job 5132110298 by maria_g

maria_g: rerun finished: nightwatch long-answer-instructions PASSED. regression cleared. marking incident resolved but opening follow-up ticket to prevent policy overlap. :white_check_mark:
